name: siftkit
description: Windows-first shell-output compression toolkit for Codex workflows.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p .\packages\contracts\tsconfig.json && tsc -p .\tsconfig.json && tsc -p .\tsconfig.scripts.json && tsc -p .\dashboard\tsconfig.json && tsc -p .\dashboard\tsconfig.node.json && npm run typecheck:bench && npm run typecheck:test && npm run typecheck:dashboard-test && npm run typecheck:analysis && npm run lint
scripts.desktop:dev: cd desktop\src-tauri && node ..\..\scripts\desktop\rust-env.mjs cargo tauri dev
scripts.desktop:build: cd desktop\src-tauri && node ..\..\scripts\desktop\rust-env.mjs cargo tauri build
scripts.test:coverage: npm run typecheck:test && npx c8 --include="src/**/*.ts" --exclude="node_modules/**" --exclude="tests/**" --reporter=text --reporter=text-summary node .\src\test-runner\run-tests.ts
scripts.test:coverage:llm: npm run typecheck:test && npx c8 --include="src/llm-protocol/**/*.ts" --include="src/agent-loop/**/*.ts" --exclude="node_modules/**" --reporter=text --reporter=text-summary node .\src\test-runner\run-tests.ts
scripts.test:live: npm run typecheck:test && powershell -Command "$env:SIFTKIT_TEST_USE_EXISTING_SERVER='1'; if (-not $env:SIFTKIT_STATUS_BACKEND_URL) { $env:SIFTKIT_STATUS_BACKEND_URL='http://127.0.0.1:4765/status' }; if (-not $env:SIFTKIT_CONFIG_SERVICE_URL) { $env:SIFTKIT_CONFIG_SERVICE_URL='http://127.0.0.1:4765/config' }; node --test --test-name-pattern 'concurrent oversized CLI summary requests' .\tests\process\runtime-cli.test.ts"
scripts.test:live:approval-cache-chain: npm run typecheck:test && powershell -Command "$env:SIFTKIT_TEST_LIVE_APPROVAL_CACHE_CHAIN='1'; if (-not $env:SIFTKIT_STATUS_BACKEND_URL) { $env:SIFTKIT_STATUS_BACKEND_URL='http://127.0.0.1:4765/status' }; if (-not $env:SIFTKIT_CONFIG_SERVICE_URL) { $env:SIFTKIT_CONFIG_SERVICE_URL='http://127.0.0.1:4765/config' }; node .\src\test-runner\run-tests.ts live-approval-cache-chain"
scripts.test:live:approval-verdict-budget: npm run typecheck:test && powershell -Command "$env:SIFTKIT_TEST_LIVE_APPROVAL_VERDICT_BUDGET='1'; if (-not $env:SIFTKIT_STATUS_BACKEND_URL) { $env:SIFTKIT_STATUS_BACKEND_URL='http://127.0.0.1:4765/status' }; if (-not $env:SIFTKIT_CONFIG_SERVICE_URL) { $env:SIFTKIT_CONFIG_SERVICE_URL='http://127.0.0.1:4765/config' }; node .\src\test-runner\run-tests.ts live-approval-verdict-budget"
scripts.test:live:repo-agent-compaction-replay: npm run typecheck:test && powershell -Command "$env:SIFTKIT_TEST_LIVE_REPO_AGENT_COMPACTION_REPLAY='1'; node .\src\test-runner\run-tests.ts live-repo-agent-compaction-replay"
